description.value: Alpine Inn & Suites is a newly renovated motel situated in the heart of Revelstoke, within easy walking distance of downtown shops, restaurants, pubs, and cafes, with mountain views visible from every room. The property offers a range of rooms and full kitchen suites, a free-use hot tub and BBQ grill, and a winter shuttle to Revelstoke Mountain Resort. Its central location near Mount Revelstoke National Park and the Columbia River makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring this mountain town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail across multiple subpages. Phone and address on the website match OSM exactly, confirming those fields; however, the OSM email (alpineinn@rctvonline.net) differs from the website email (info@alpineinnrevelstoke.com), flagged as a concern. No mention of bike-specific storage or bike procedures appears anywhere on the site; nearby grocery and evening food are explicitly confirmed, as are Wi-Fi and in-room USB device charging. The amenities page mentions 'electric charger available for trailers on our exterior wall' but this refers to vehicle/trailer charging, not e-bikes specifically, so e-bike charging remains null.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists alpineinn@rctvonline.net but the website consistently shows info@alpineinnrevelstoke.com across all subpages — OSM email may be outdated.

The 'Sustainable Tourism' section on the homepage refers to 'Swiss Chalet Motel' rather than Alpine Inn & Suites, suggesting boilerplate text was copied from a different property — minor credibility note.
The contact page contains the word 'Dhaka' in what appears to be a city/label field, likely a website template artifact rather than a real concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly bookable motel in Revelstoke with a functioning website and confirmed contact details; useful to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation in a mountain town.
enrichment_extras.notes: Parking lot explicitly accommodates long trailers up to 19 m and has an exterior wall electric charger described as for trailers — could be relevant to cyclists towing e-bike trailers but is not confirmed as e-bike charging.

Nearby evening food.detail: About page: 'Within short walking distance, you can find many shops, restaurants, pubs, cafes & lounges.'

Nearby grocery.detail: About page states 'there is a very big supermarket within walking distance'; amenities page confirms 'minutes walking to downtown commercial area with grocery store.'

Device charging.detail: Amenities page lists 'clock with USB charger' as standard in-room equipment in every room

wow_evidence: free-use hot tub and BBQ grill... central location near Mount Revelstoke National Park
